items.title: 17.7.1 Magnesium from Seawater (Dow Process) (samandari paani se magnesium) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 17.7.1 with an added flow chart (not printed in the book), printed pages 9-10.

blocks.text: Yeh shayad sab se mashhoor aur industry (sanat) ke liye sab se ahem tareeqa hai. "Dow Process" (ya is ki milti julti shaklein) kai steps (qadmon) wala chemical aur electrochemical tareeqa hai jis se samandar ke paani mein maujood magnesium ions (Mg²⁺) ke bohat bare reserves (zakheere) se magnesium metal nikali jati hai.

blocks.alt: Paanch dabbon ka flow chart oopar se neeche: samandari paani Mg2+(aq); + Ca(OH)2 se Mg(OH)2 neeche baith'ta hai; chhaan kar + 2HCl se MgCl2(aq) + 2H2O; garha kar, sukha kar aur pighla kar molten MgCl2; electrolysis se cathode par Mg aur anode par Cl2.
blocks.caption: Dow process ke steps: samandari paani se magnesium (is topic ke liye hamari apni drawing; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chart upar se neeche teen steps dikhata hai: (1) Ca(OH)₂ dalne se Mg(OH)₂ neeche baith jata hai, (2) Mg(OH)₂ ko HCl se MgCl₂ banaya jata hai, (3) pighle hue MgCl₂ ki electrolysis se cathode par Mg aur anode par Cl₂ milti hai. Yeh chart kitab mein nahi; samajhne ke liye banaya gaya hai.

Samandar ke paani mein calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)₂) milaya jata hai, jo limestone ya seepiyon (oyster shells) se banaya jata hai. Yeh magnesium ko na ghulne wale (insoluble) magnesium hydroxide (Mg(OH)₂) ki shakal mein precipitate kar deta hai (neeche bitha deta hai).
Magnesium hydroxide ko filter kar ke (chhaan kar) hydrochloric acid (HCl) se react karaya jata hai, jis se magnesium chloride (MgCl₂) banta hai.

Phir magnesium chloride ke solution ko garha (concentrate) aur khushk kiya jata hai. Pighle hue (molten) MgCl₂ ki bare electrolytic cells mein electrolysis ki jati hai. Yeh aakhri step hai jis mein cathode par pure (khalis) magnesium metal aur anode par chlorine gas banti hai.

Yeh tareeqa apni ingenuity (aqalmandi) ki wajah se mashhoor hai: yeh aam milne wale magar kam concentration wale zariye (samandar ka paani) se qeemti metal bohat bare industrial scale (paimane) par nikalta hai. Is ne magnesium ki production (paidawar) ka tareeqa hi badal diya.

blocks.prompt: Dow Process ke electrolysis wale step ki equation likhein.
blocks.explanation: Mg²⁺(l) + 2Cl⁻(l) → Mg(l) + Cl₂(g): cathode par magnesium aur anode par chlorine.

items: Ca(OH)₂ samandar ke paani se Mg(OH)₂ precipitate karta hai.
Pighle MgCl₂ ki electrolysis: cathode par Mg, anode par Cl₂.
